issues.title: P23D/P24E ablation and P22C maturity conflict
issues.detail: PA 1/2026: P23D scout harvesting started Jan 2026; P24E ablation planned June 2026. Agro 1/2026 5.2.7: P23D has three ablation rounds this year, ablation already started. PA 1/2026 intro says P22C maturity extended to January 2026; section 11.1.1 says maturity scheduled January 2027.

issues.title: Replanting section in Agro looks mislabelled
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 section 6 'Replanting (March 2026 – P25F & FTR 235.20 ha)' reports 30,190 palms (87%) — this matches P25F (PA: 30,380 seedlings, planted Aug 2025). The actual 2026 replant P26G (ex-P93C, 141.30 ha, 6,902 seedlings) is not described in Agro.

issues.title: Barn owl occupancy
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 14: 160 nests, 156 occupied, 98%. Agro 1/2026 Table 10: same rows (sum 156) but total printed as 80 occupied, 83%, on 2,054.00 ha.

issues.title: Rainfall records disagree
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Appendix 1 2025 total 2,444.00 mm (126 days) vs Agro 1/2026 Appendix 2 2,593.5 mm (125 days) (Oct 114.50 vs 265.5); Agro 2/2025 shows completely different 2025 months (Jan–Oct 2,151 mm, e.g. Apr 1,043). 2022: PA 2,805.80 mm vs Agro 2,992.5 mm; PA's 2022 column is identical to Batu Agro 2/2025's 2023 column. 2026: PA Feb 149.50 mm vs Agro 49.5 mm.

issues.title: General charges text vs table
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 5.1 says GC RM391.09/ha is 30% lower than a to-date budget of RM559.17; Table 6 budget is RM599.17 (35% lower). Bonus printed 'RM128.894'. Table 6 total RM1,082,393.78 vs Appendix 2 RM1,079,637.04 (management sub-total 519,030.91 vs 516,942.41). Executive count text says 'hiring of additional executive' explains non-executive salaries overrun.

issues.title: Agro manuring table oddities

issues.detail: PA 1/2026 2.3 says 'part of field P94B (159.50 ha)' to be felled June 2026; Agro Table 5 shows P93B B3–B5 (159.40 ha). Agro Table 5 lists F6 in both 2028 (65.80 ha) and 2029 (70.50 ha); F7 (65.8) is missing. PA 1/2026 Table 8–9 P20B ha 229.20 vs 204.10 elsewhere; P93C circle/selective tables still show 141.30 ha after clearing.

kb:
LADANG SUNGAI GAYUNG - FACT PACK (Far East Holdings Berhad, Far East group). Estate Manager En. Romeli Bin Mohamad; Regional Senior Manager En. Musa Bin Abdul Halim. Assistant Manager En. Muhamad Zulfadhli Bin Abdul Rahman (from 1 Dec 2025); executives En. Mohamad Haris Bin Zulkafley and En. Muhammad Amirul Ehsan Bin Anwar (joined 17 Nov 2025); Chief Clerk Irwan Mirdani Bin Aimi (from 1 Feb 2026).

SOURCES. (1) Planting Advisory (PA) Report 1/2026, visit 13 May 2026, period January to April 2026, by Planting Advisor En. Mohd Sufian Bin Yusoff; previous PA visit 13 November 2025 (PA 2/2025, Jan-Oct 2025). (2) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 16 April 2026, by Junior Agronomist En. Alison Janari with Senior Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming; previous visit 18/20 November 2025 (Agro 2/2025, which drew up the 2026 programme). Agro 1/2025 (30 June 2025, Mr. Lai Heng Hong) holds the 2025 programme.

AREA (PA 1/2026, April 2026). Total 2,384.27 ha; planted 2,314.30 ha: mature 1,410.50 ha (59%), immature 737.40 ha plus 25.10 ha supply bund in P20B (762.50 ha), replanting P26G (ex-P93C) 141.30 ha; buildings 13.80 ha; unplantable swamp (blocks 14I/19J) 56.17 ha. Mature fields (ha, SPH): P93A 295.10 (129), P93B 241.70 (131), P94F 474.70 (129), P98G 67.90 (134), P06H 6.70 (131), P20A 120.30 (140), P20B 204.10 (140). Immature: P22C 108.20, P23D 181.40, P24E 212.60, P25F + TR 235.20. Age: old mature over 19 years 1,086.10 ha (46.93%), young mature 4-8 years 324.40 ha, immature 762.50 ha, replant 141.30 ha; no prime palms. P93C (141.30 ha) cleared January 2026; P93B B3-B5 (about 159.5 ha) to be felled June 2026. Replanting of old palms rescheduled to finish by 2028 (Agro table: 2026 P93B/P93C 300.70 ha; 2027 P93A/P93B 300.80; 2028 P93A1 and P94F 305.70; 2029 P94F, P98G, P06H 320.20). Weighted hectares advised for yield and costing.

LABOUR (PA, April 2026). 167 workers vs 178 required: harvesters 68 vs 75; driver/loader 11 vs 13; weeding 27 vs 39; manuring 12 vs 14; mandore 4 vs 7; general 13 vs 10; others/replanting 32 vs 20. Ratio 1 worker per 14 ha; 1 harvester per 21 ha. In 4 months 34 recruited, 2 returned, 4 transferred in; 22 repatriated, 11 absconded, 1 unfit, 14 transferred out. Five contractors with 137 workers (Sjh Jaya, Hasron Norraimi, Mazwar, Rismawati, Supermandore). Watermelon growers' workers help in immature and replanting areas.

CROP (PA 1/2026 Table 19). Jan-Apr 2026 FFB 6,558.60 t on 1,410.50 ha vs budget 8,203.00 t (1,551.80 ha); 20% below. Yield 4.65 t/ha vs 5.29 budget; annual budget 25,550.00 t, 16.46 t/ha. Jan-Apr 2025 9,113.84 t, 5.13 t/ha (1,775.40 ha). Full year 2025 29,397.57 t, 17.67 t/ha (1,663.60 ha). CPO 1,292.04 t, OER 19.70%; kernel 327.93 t, KER 5.00%. By field Jan-Apr 2026 (t, t/ha, vs budget t): P93A 1,116.60, 3.78 (1,669.00); P93B 959.80, 3.97 (868.00); P93C 134.24, 0.95 (497.00, harvesting ended Feb); P94F 2,688.05, 5.66 (2,825.00); P98G 461.26, 6.79 (492.00); P06H 42.03, 6.27 (55.00); P20A 568.40, 4.72 (754.00); P20B 588.22, 2.88 (1,043.00). P20B needs attention.
Earlier: 2024 33,217.12 t, 18.87 t/ha (20.79 excluding first-year areas); 2023 14.56 t/ha; 2022 16.55 t/ha. Jan-Oct 2025 25,174.87 t, 14.98 t/ha, 10% above budget, 13% below Jan-Oct 2024. Agro 1/2026: 2025 yield 17.68 t/ha, -7% on 2024 (P93A 17.59, P93B 17.61, P93C 20.36, P94F 18.69, P98G 23.54, P06H 29.18, P20A 17.14, P20B 13.04). Jan-Mar 2026 3.25 t/ha vs 3.38 (-4%); P20B, P20A, P94F, P98G up; P93B, P93A, P06H down. Agro blames prolonged droughts and uneven rainfall for 2025-2026 yield depression, and old palms in decline.

HARVESTING. Average interval 15 days, 8.00 rounds Jan-Apr; no ripe bunches left; loose fruit recovery satisfactory; over 95% ripe at grading. Productivity 1.44 t/man-day; earnings RM61.54-RM107.31/day; harvesting rate RM57.00/t old palms, RM84.00/t P20A/P20B, RM41.00/t P06H. Mechanisation on P93A, P93B, P94F (1,011.50 ha): 2 mini tractors (8.79 t/machine-day, 1.64 t/harvester) and 8 Timac (9.14 and 1.81), below potential; extend to P20A/P20B. Agro: intervals up to 20 days in Q1, brought back by the visit; long-stalk bunches at P93A.

COST (PA Table 22, Jan-Apr 2026, RM per t FFB, actual vs budget): general charges 164.61 vs 195.95; upkeep and cultivation 129.16 vs 97.71; harvesting and collection 113.22 vs 112.04; ex-estate total 406.99 vs 405.70 (annual budget 394.88). Including processing 79.31, palm oil transport 11.83, tax 3.57, windfall tax 24.35 and depreciation 17.33, grand total RM543.38 vs 538.35. Upkeep overspend from bund raising and supplying in 25.10 ha of P20B; lower crop raised cost per tonne. General charges RM391.09/ha vs RM599.17 budget; overspent: non-executive salaries +30% (RM130,892, extra executive and supervisor), bonus +17% (interim bonus), labour quarters +35% (furniture for 34 new workers), entertainment +23%, ISCC +55%. Upkeep RM/ha (actual vs budget): weeding 90.89 vs 103.07; manuring 254.77 vs 268.30; pest and disease 9.76 vs 31.88; census 1.63 vs 2.08; drains 29.89 vs 15.48 (+93%); roads 41.14 vs 66.28 (fuel prices); supplying 41.77 (not budgeted, RM66,023); boundary 7.03 vs 8.01; pruning 59.03 vs 56.75; total 535.91 vs 551.86. Harvesting labour RM74.25/t, internal transport 31.60, external transport 7.37.

MANURING. Mature programme to April 2026: 375.00 t required, 373.25 delivered, 309.05 applied - on schedule (Jan Mix B 97.85 and NK2 1.75 done; Feb NK2 175.80 done; Apr Mix B 33.65 of 97.85 applied). Applied on frond-stack periphery in tall palms and in circles in young mature; semi-mechanised MB with fibreglass bucket, 30-35 bags/day, RM75-77/day. Agro (16 April): April round not started, waiting for stock; store partly open to rain with wet floor and torn bags. 2025 programme completed early December 2025.
Revised 2026 programme (Agro 1/2026, g per palm), cut because of a big fertiliser price rise and limited stock: P93A, P93B none (replanting 2026/2027); P94F NK2 2,500 Feb only (August round dropped); P98G NK2 2,500 Feb and Aug; P06H NK2 2,000 Jan and May, Mix B 2,000 Oct; P20A and P20B Mix B 2,000 Jan and Apr, kieserite 500 Jun, Mix B 1,500 Jul, RP 1,500 Sep, Mix B 1,500 Oct (originally 2,000); P22C Mix B 1,500 Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct, RP 1,500 Sep; P23D Compound B 1,000 Jan, 1,200 Apr, Jul, Oct, RP 1,500 Sep; P24E Compound A 800 Feb, May, Jul, 1,000 Oct, RP 1,500 Mar; P25F Compound A 800 Jul, 900 Oct, RP 1,500 Aug; new replant 600 g CRF + 500 g RP in the hole, nothing for 9 months, then Compound A 800 g and RP 1,500 g. 2027 programme in the second agronomy report.

WEEDING. Circle 1,656.10 ha vs 1,926.40 ha programme to date; selective 1,845.50 ha; palm circles generally satisfactory, noxious weeds mostly eradicated. Keep circle spraying within 2 m, not on paths; circle raking in tall palm fields; roto-slasher for tall grass. Agro: P93C and P94F behind; P20A/P20B weeding delayed (87-89%) with Clidemia, Asystasia, VOPs in inter-terrace zones; immature areas slightly behind; Mucuna well established, watermelon interplanted in inter-rows.

PESTS AND DISEASES. No significant pests. Rat damage March 2026: P93A 5%, P93B 5%, P94F 3%, P98G 4%, P06H 5%, P20A 10%, P20B 10%, P22C 4%; one round of STORM baiting over 324.40 ha of P20A/P20B. 160 barn owl nests (1 per 14 ha), 156 occupied (98%); none yet in P24E and P25F. Predator host plants 366 of 10,000 chains programmed (3.67%). Ganoderma: suspected symptoms below threshold; census in progress; deboling fallen stumps, exposing to sun, shredding at replanting; only dry fronds to be pruned in infested fields. Immature: sporadic rat and Oryctes in P23D; leaf-eating and leaf-borer spraying in P25F.

PRUNING. Progressive pruning done on all 1,410.50 ha mature; adequate fronds and good stacking; avoid over-pruning in young mature and Ganoderma fields. P20A/P20B frond stacking not yet to standard.

DRAINS, ROADS, SUPPLYING. P20B low-lying 25.10 ha: drains built and bund raised above flood level, 1,500 palms supplied (2026). Some drains silted after recent floods; culvert to reinstall. Roads good; laterite soggy stretches; inspect in rain for scuppers. Supplying records 2019-2026 total 12,491 palms (P20B 8,422).

IMMATURE AND REPLANT. P22C (108.20 ha): scout harvesting since June 2025, maturity January 2027, cost to date RM16,608.79/ha. P23D (181.40 ha): scout harvesting from January 2026, RM16,348.56/ha; peat 47.6 ha. P24E (212.60 ha): 16 months old, ablation from June 2026 (3 rounds, 2-month interval), RM12,532.53/ha. P25F (235.20 ha): planted by August 2025 with 30,380 Yangambi DxP seedlings, 3,150 chains of 16 ft terraces, RM7,587.03/ha. P26G (ex-P93C, 141.30 ha): felled Jan-Feb 2026, 6,902 seedlings planted by April from Dawn nursery, completion by June-August 2026, 100 ha watermelon interplanting for 2 years, 42 ha Mucuna, RM1,109.03/ha. Target immaturity 30-36 months.

CAPEX AND VEHICLES. 2026 budget RM13,667,629.00; spent RM1,612,620.00 (replanting RM1,607,385.00 of RM13,548,529.00; computer RM5,235.00). Quotes needed for record room (RM80,000) and 8-t trailer (RM20,000). John Deere tractor RM11.25/hr vs RM6.84 budget (under-used, diesel price); Electric Ginga RM3.42/hr vs RM1.92 (under-used).

RAINFALL. Agro 1/2026 totals: 2020 1,929.5 mm; 2021 2,679.5; 2022 2,992.5; 2023 2,843; 2024 2,241; 2025 2,593.5 mm (125 days); Jan-Mar 2026 168.5 mm. PA prints 2025 as 2,444.00 mm and Jan-Apr 2026 as 410.00 mm.

KEY ADVICE. Bait and re-census rats in P20A/P20B; quarterly censuses; Ganoderma census and sanitation in tall palms; thin and supply P20B; check P20B yield components; weeding catch-up in young mature; protect fertiliser stock and expedite application; correct long-stalk bunches; extend mechanisation; drain upkeep; re-block large immature blocks; focus on immature growth, timely fertiliser and pest control.
